title: Punjab Consolidation of Holdings Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Consolidation of Holdings Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XLII OF 2001
PUNJAB
CONSOLIDATION OF HOLDINGS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XLII OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the Punjab Consolidation of Holdings
Ordinance, 1960
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 14th
November, 2001 ]
No. Legis.13-82/2001, dated 13-112001.--The
following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby
published
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Punjab Consolidation of Holdings (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall be deemed to have
come into force on and from the 14th day of August, 2001.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Consolidation of Holdings Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Amendment in section 2 of Ordinance VI of 1960

ORDINANCE XLII OF 2001
PUNJAB
CONSOLIDATION OF HOLDINGS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XLII OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the Punjab Consolidation of Holdings
Ordinance, 1960
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 14th
November, 2001 ]
No. Legis.13-82/2001, dated 13-112001.--The
following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby
published
2. Amendment in section 2 of Ordinance VI of 1960.--In the said
Ordinance, in section 2---
(i) Clause (c) shall be
substituted by the following:--
"(c)
"Collector" means Collector appointed under the Punjab Land Revenue
Act, 1967 (XVII of 1967) and includes any other officer specially empowered by
the Board of Revenue to perform the functions of a Collector; ".
(ii) Clause (d) shall be
substituted by the following:-- _
"(d)
"Executive District Officer (Revenue)" means the Executive District
Officer (Revenue) of a District and includes any other officer specially
empowered by the Board of Revenue to perform the functions of an Executive
District Officer (Revenue) under this Ordinance;".
